Name: Additional Chicken
Author: bansaighdear
Description:
This adds four chickens to Marnies' animal shop:

[list]
[*]Berry colored chicken (dark pink)
[*]Petrol colored chicken (bluegreen)
[*]Gradient colored chicken ("Bicolor")
[*]Gradient colored chicken ("Sunset")
[/list]
each one comes with corresponding eggs and chicks.
Also adds a new sound for the new chickens.

Manifest.Name: Additional Colored Chicken
Manifest.Description: Adds chickens and chicks in four new colors plus their eggs. Does not recolor the original chickens and chicks and eggs.
Manifest.Author: bansaighdear
